visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown-dyed hair and a white button-down shirt over a light grey t-shirt sits at a white table. He holds a small circular container of white cream and a tiny jar of red jam. His facial expression is animated, eyes wide and mouth moving as he speaks to the camera. Several open cardboard food boxes are scattered on the table in front of him. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of a scone held in his hand. He uses a metal fork to scoop a large portion of thick white cream and spreads it generously over the surface of the halved pastry. His hands are steady and focused on the task. (3) He then uses the fork to take dollops of dark red strawberry jam from a small glass jar, layering it heavily over the white cream on the scone. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the food. (4) The shot returns to a medium framing of the man. He smiles broadly and laughs while holding the scone, looking slightly off-camera as if interacting with someone behind the lens. He gestures with the scone toward the camera. (5) A quick visual insert appears, showing a news broadcast meme of a man wearing a red shirt and glasses screaming into a microphone. This is overlaid on top of the scone footage. (6) The man takes a large bite of the prepared scone, closing his eyes briefly as he chews. He nods his head vigorously and points to the scone with his finger, exhibiting a satisfied and impressed facial expression. (7) A final graphic screen appears with a beige background. It features a smaller video frame of the man eating noodles, the YouTube channel name '@志祺日常', and a call to action with a downward arrow.
